items.title: Ruth Brisbane interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, April 2, 2013
items.q: So I auditioned and I worked with so many wonderful musicians. The best part of working “Black and Blue” was like Claude “Fiddler” [Williams], Bill Dillard

ctx.x: What was that like, being in Paris and getting paid to do what you like?

Oh it was wonderful, wonderful. I love Paris and as the song says “I Love Paris.” And it was the wintertime. It opened in December. One of the leads, she had work to do in New York, or concerts to do. And she wanted to go out and do the concerts and come back, but they said no, if you leave, you know, you’re turning it over to someone else.
